authorization_reference: THEMESCOPE_CODEX_MASTER.md sections 1, 5 and 6 authorize evidence-reviewed membership expansion in this redevelopment; immutable forward additions only.
evidence_method: Issuer company profiles inspected with the web reader on the review date. Fingerprints hash the exact short supporting excerpt encoded as UTF-8, not the unavailable full page body. Summaries are paraphrased; no raw page or private market prices are distributed.

evidence.support_summary: Century Communities and Century Complete build single-family homes, townhomes, paired homes and condos. Principal homebuilding matches the existing residential construction charter.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Land Development & Homebuilding as a Public Company
evidence.support_summary: The issuer describes a residential land-development and homebuilding company operating consolidated homebuilder brands. Principal residential construction supports Core membership.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: The homebuilding unit sells and constructs homes under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes brands.
evidence.support_summary: NVR constructs and sells residential homes; its mortgage operations support those homebuyers. Homebuilding is a principal operating business, matching the existing Core charter.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: M/I Homes, Inc. founded in 1976, M/I Homes is one of nation's leading builders of single family homes.
evidence.support_summary: The issuer identifies its principal business as single-family homebuilding, serving multiple residential buyer segments. This directly matches the existing Homebuilders Core definition.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Through its water utility subsidiary, Golden State Water Company, the company provides water service to approximately 265,200 customer connections
evidence.support_summary: Golden State Water supplies regulated water service; American States Utility Services operates military-base water and wastewater systems. Water is a material operating business, supporting Core rather than incidental exposure.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Together, these companies provide regulated and non-regulated water and wastewater service to more than 2 million people
evidence.support_summary: The group operates regulated water utilities and related water/wastewater services. Principal water distribution and treatment meet the existing Water Core charter.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Middlesex Water engages in collecting, treating, distributing and selling water for domestic, commercial, municipal, industrial and fire protection purposes.
evidence.support_summary: Middlesex owns and operates regulated water and wastewater systems and provides contract operations. Principal water utility activities directly support Core membership.
